name: Deep sofa cleaning
summary: How expats book deep sofa cleaning in Singapore — fabric vs leather methods, mildew odours after humidity spikes, and drying-time planning in small flats.
body:
Deep sofa cleaning extracts sweat, food spills, and mildew smells that surface wiping misses. Fabric, microfibre, and leather need different chemistry; rushed jobs leave damp cushions that smell worse the next day.

## Typical jobs
- Hot-water extraction for fabric sofas
- Leather clean and condition
- Urine / pet odour treatments
- Mattress add-on cleans
- Stain-guard options after cleaning

Ask about drying time before kids and pets climb back on.

## How to choose
Prefer cleaners who test a hidden patch and state drying windows. Avoid one-price quotes that ignore fabric type. Confirm whether cushions are cleaned on both sides.

## Practical tip
Run the AC and point a fan at the sofa after the crew leaves. Humidity turns a “same-day dry” claim into an overnight damp couch.
